decisions.reason: The client explicitly refines the leak-free acceptance condition to require an uninterrupted liquid test followed by confirmation that the underside remains dry.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Thank you for the video. This is the kind of progress update I’ve been requesting, and the spin test looks good. Prior to shipment, I’d like one last uninterrupted test with liquid that shows both stations running, liquid dispensing through both spouts, and the machine operating for several minutes without any leaks. Afterward, please also briefly show the underside of the machine so we can confirm that everything remains dry. When that test has been completed, we can coordinate the final shipment.

[CLIENT_NAME_001] Burton

value_updates.leak_free_acceptance_condition: In one uninterrupted test with liquid, both dispensing paths must operate for several minutes without leaks.
value_updates.post_test_underside_condition: The underside of the machine must remain dry after the liquid test.

decisions.reason: The source requires both stations to appear in the final demonstration but does not change the existing simultaneous-operation requirement.
The final liquid-test protocol does not change any component selection, compatibility rule, or BOM deliverable.
Dispensing through both spouts during the test does not change their geometry, material, mounting location, orientation, or pour direction.
The source requires demonstration of dispensing but does not alter the established valve, button, flow-control, or dispensing-sequence behavior.
Briefly showing the underside to confirm dryness is an inspection step and does not modify underside accessibility or serviceability.
The source reports that the spin test looks good and requests further liquid testing, but it establishes no new structural-stability or vibration constraint.
The operational test request does not change the system-layout or CAD deliverable and imposes no new CAD retention requirement.
The source does not modify the wiring-plan content, completion status, or documentation-retention requirement.
Several minutes of operation is specified as part of the acceptance demonstration, not as a new motor durability or maximum-speed duty constraint.
The liquid test and underside inspection do not change dispensing-path removability, cleaning methods, sanitation access, or liquid-trap prevention.
Dispensing through both spouts during testing does not change the platform height, footprint, supported cup size, or clearance purpose.
